Q2.assessment: Accepted as conservative English-label protection. The complete image/representation family supports a made likeness as well as mental and optical images. Model can denote a representation; the new note explicitly distinguishes that from an exemplar to follow rather than claiming unrestricted Japanese synonymy.

Q3.assessment: Accepted as a bounded no-established-collision decision. The actual label surround; enclose names an action; neither the attested exemplary pattern nor delimited frame establishes that action for 範. Conversely, the actual 囲 article and character entry include enclosure and abstract surroundings but do not establish model; standard. This is a lexical assessment in both directions, not a rule that different parts of speech are always safe.

Q4.assessment: Accepted on the supplied evidence. The full 1516925/1516930 families and character section preserve direction, method, region, field, type/category and length-of-a-square senses. Neither those category associations nor whole-word 範疇 makes direction/method an attested gloss for 範, or model/standard a demonstrated gloss for 方. Q5.assessment: Accepted. The character's standard/exemplar branch independently supports the reverse displayed model; standard choice. Degree, occurrence, ruler and scale marks are not collapsed into that branch. The full occurrence/degree families and the search-only/obsolete restrictions in 2252690 remain separate.

Q6.assessment: Accepted as conservative protection for the noun reading of English measure. Complete 1438050 gives a transverse measurement, while the character source separates counting/measuring, instruments and plans. The note does not claim that 範 is a measuring device or an ordinary measuring verb.

Q7.assessment: Accepted as conservative measurement-label protection, not proof that every sense of English gauge applies. The character source and complete 1600650 distinguish dimensional measurement and inference. The shared nori family's measurement result supplies the stated concern; no unrestricted はかる or spelling substitution is taught.

Q8.assessment: Accepted as a cautious quantity/dimension comparison. The character and complete 1554640 sources preserve measured magnitude/amount and distinguish capacity instruments, generosity and philosophical senses. A measured extent may be expressed as an amount of length; the note does not promote quantity itself to an exemplary standard.

Q9.assessment: Accepted as bounded, with the moral-principle association retained. The independently read 理 entry and complete 1957060/2412900 families support reason, logic and underlying principle; 1454260 supports those glosses for 道理. The human right-conduct sense of nori is not thereby an attested explanatory reason or logical inference, nor is every underlying principle an exemplary model or prescribed standard. The disposition does not deny moral principles or infer general harmlessness from differing labels.
